extraFacts.fact: Corrugated metal hose terms: annular corrugation is a series of parallel rings (versus helical, a continuous spiral); braid is a woven wire sleeve that contains pressure; ISO 10380 covers corrugated metal hoses and hose assemblies, with a safety factor of 4:1 on burst pressure as quoted in the listings; hoses are hydrotested at 1.5 times working pressure.

faqs.q: What is the Adflex Commercial Grade Metallic Hose used for?
faqs.a: The Adflex Commercial Grade Metallic Hose is a annular corrugated metallic hose in the Stainless SS Corrugated family. Typical uses include process plant utility transfer, compressed gas / steam connector lines and vibration absorption on rotating equipment. See the [stainless corrugated hoses](/c/metallic-stainless-corrugated-hoses).

faqs.q: Which standards apply to the Adflex Commercial Grade Metallic Hose?
faqs.a: The Adflex Commercial Grade Metallic Hose lists several standards and certificates. Listed: ISO 10380:2012 (Corrugated Metal Hoses and Hose Assemblies); Pressure Equipment Directive 2014/68/EU Module H; EN 10204 3.1 / 3.2 mill test reports on request. Ask on your request for the certificates the project needs and we confirm what is available before supply.

faqs.q: What sizes does the Adflex Commercial Grade Metallic Hose come in?
faqs.a: The Adflex Commercial Grade Metallic Hose is listed with a nominal ID range of DN 6 (1/4") to DN 300 (12"). Minimum bend radius is 25 mm minimum (static / dynamic) with the OEM figures; confirm the size on your request.

faqs.q: What pressure and temperature can the Adflex Commercial Grade Metallic Hose take?
faqs.a: The Adflex Commercial Grade Metallic Hose has working pressure to 100 bar, operating temperature -200°C to +650°C. Maximum working pressure 100 bar at the smallest bore (decreases with increasing diameter — refer to the OEM size table for per-size ratings). Minimum burst pressure 400 bar with safety factor 4:1 per ISO 10380. Pressure falls as bore and temperature rise, so give the full duty.

faqs.q: What is the Adflex Commercial Grade Metallic Hose made of?
faqs.a: The Adflex Commercial Grade Metallic Hose has core material Type 316L SS, braid Single Braid — Type 304 SS and end fitting material Carbon steel ASTM A105, 304SS or 316SS — flange / NPT / sanitary / camlock per order. Construction type: stainless SS Corrugated — Commercial-grade annular corrugated.

faqs.q: what standards and certifications does the Adflex Commercial Grade Metallic Hose meet?
faqs.a: ISO 10380:2012. PED 2014/68/EU Module H. EN 10204 3.1 / 3.2 mill test reports supplied on request. Pressure-test certificate (1.5× working pressure) included with every assembly.

faqs.q: What do I send to order the Adflex Commercial Grade Metallic Hose?
faqs.a: To order the Adflex Commercial Grade Metallic Hose, confirm (a) line working pressure and process medium, (b) operating temperature range, (c) bore size and overall length. (d) end fitting type per side (NPT / BSPP / ANSI 150-1500# RF / DIN PN10-PN40 / sanitary tri-clamp / camlock / butt-weld / etc.), (e) braid configuration (unbraided / single / double / triple — drives pressure rating), (f) any required certifications (ISO 10380, PED Module, ASME conformance, NACE MR0175, CGA / UL / Chlorine Institute).

faqs.q: What bend radius and weight does the Adflex Commercial Grade Metallic Hose have?
faqs.a: The Adflex Commercial Grade Metallic Hose lists a minimum bend radius of 25 mm minimum. Keep the bend radius above the minimum, and do not twist the hose in service.

faqs.q: Adflex Commercial Grade Metallic Hose: what is the construction (cover / lining / reinforcement)?
faqs.a: Lining (core): Type 316L SS — annular corrugated corrugated profile. Reinforcement (braid): Single Braid of Type 304 SS. End fittings: Carbon steel ASTM A105, 304SS or 316SS — flange / NPT / sanitary / camlock per order. The corrugation profile and braid weave are matched at the OEM to deliver the rated pressure containment with the design bend-radius envelope (25 mm static minimum, 100 mm dynamic).

faqs.q: Where is the Adflex Commercial Grade Metallic Hose typically used?
faqs.a: The Adflex Commercial Grade Metallic Hose has several listed uses. Listed uses: process plant utility transfer; compressed gas / steam connector lines; vibration absorption on rotating equipment; pump suction / discharge connectors.

In detail: working pressure to 100 bar, operating temperature -200°C to +650°C here against working pressure to 175 bar, operating temperature -200°C to +650°C there; braid single Braid — Type 304 SS here and triple Braid — Type 304 SS on the other.
